title: Half-Day San Francisco City Overview Tour
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Short on time but want to see the whole city? This half-day overview hits every major San Francisco highlight, including the Golden Gate Bridge, Coit Tower, Painted Ladies, Alcatraz views, and more, plus the neighborhoods and local spots that make SF unlike anywhere else. 

Travel by luxury van with a small group and a guide who actually knows the city, stopping for photos at viewpoints the big buses can't access. 

It's the single best way to get your bearings in San Francisco.
